classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: Steady prep (1); periodic stirring of the sauce (1); sauced pasta plus ricotta layer (1); brown, simmer, bake (0, same as mushroom bolognese); sauce pan and pasta pot attended in parallel plus a baking dish (1, herbed-polenta precedent). Sum 4 -> moderate. Complexity: 11 countable (1). All mainstream supermarket (0). One Italian-American tomato-sausage profile; the ricotta takes only salt, pepper, and basil from the same profile (0). Sum 1 -> simple. Borderline if the ricotta seasoning is read as a second build (would be 2 -> standard).

factor_key_note: Fourth complexity factor stored as pantry_familiarity (the key in the 50 Vale-audited classifications, d03-design/all-50-classifications.json); kept 0 because specialty-store sourcing is scored once under specialty_burden.
